IILM vs NIMS University: MBA Comparison – Accreditation, Placement & Scope

Students comparing IILM University and NIMS University are typically weighing a specific trade-off: a Delhi NCR campus with direct corporate placement access against a Jaipur-based multi-disciplinary university with a broader programme range. This guide compares IILM vs NIMS University on the parameters that matter most for MBA decisions, accreditation, rankings, programme structure, placement ecosystem, and location advantage, using verified data from official sources.

IILM vs NIMS University — At a Glance

 

Parameter	IILM University	NIMS University
Founded	1994 (30+ years)	2008 (NIMS University Act, Rajasthan)
Location	Gurugram (Golf Course Road) and Greater Noida — Delhi NCR	NH-11C, Delhi–Jaipur Expressway, Shobha Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan (205 km from Delhi)
Campus Size	Focused urban campuses in NCR — direct proximity to the corporate belt	250 acres — large residential township-style campus, surrounded by Aravalli hills
UGC Recognition	Yes — both Gurugram and Greater Noida campuses are UGC recognised	Yes — recognised under Section 2(f) of UGC Act, 1956
NAAC Accreditation	NAAC: under process for all campuses — not yet awarded. Source: iilm.ac.in Public Self-Disclosure document	NAAC accredited (exact current grade: verify at naac.gov.in)
NIRF Ranking	Management Band 101-125 (2024); BT #47 (2025); India Today MBA #42 (2024); Career360 AAA+	Overall Band 151-200 (2025); University Band 101-150 (2025); Pharmacy #79 (2025); QS Asian Rankings (S. Asia) #362 (2026)
Primary Strengths	Management, Law, Engineering — focused disciplines with NCR placement access	Medical (MBBS flagship), Pharmacy, Dental, Nursing, Engineering, Law, Management — broadest multi-disciplinary range in Rajasthan
MBA Specialisations	10+: Finance & FinTech, AI & Analytics with HCL Tech, Marketing & Psychology, HRM & Psychology, Operations with Blue Ocean Group, ESG & Sustainability, Law & Public Policy, Entrepreneurship with T-Hub	25+ MBA specialisations: Marketing, Finance, HR, IT, Operations, SCM, Digital Marketing, Hospital & Healthcare Management, Banking, Event Management, Retail, Project Management, Pharmaceutical Management, International Business, Aviation, Media & Entertainment, Sports Management, Travel & Tourism, and more (via NIMS School of Business)
Placement Record (MBA)	Rs 26 LPA highest; Rs 8.6 LPA avg; Rs 13.64 LPA top 10% avg CTC; 500+ recruiters; 100% placement assistance (Batch 2024-26, official)	Rs 1 Crore highest package (nimsuniversity.org/nims-school-of-business/ — official); 2,000+ active recruiters; named recruiters from official site: TCS, Infosys, Google, Wipro, Apollo, Fortis, Cipla. MBA-specific average not separately published — verify directly.

IILM data: apply.iilm.edu/mba-pgdm-2026/ (official — placement figures, specialisations, MBA Batch 2024-26). Business Today 2025; India Today 2024; NIRF 2024 Management Band 101-125. NIMS data: Shiksha.com (NIRF 2025 Pharmacy #79, Overall 151-200, University 101-150, QS Asian #362); nimsuniversity.org/nims-school-of-business/ (official — 25+ MBA specialisations, Rs 1 Crore highest package, 2,000+ recruiters, fetched July 2026); nimsuniversity.org/faq.php (UGC recognised, NAAC accredited, TCS/Infosys/Google/Wipro confirmed); NIRF 2025 (Pharmacy #79, Overall 151-200, University 101-150); Shiksha.com (QS Asian #362).

 

Rankings and Accreditation — IILM vs NIMS

IILM University: Ranked #47 by Business Today (2025) and #42 for MBA by India Today (2024). NIRF Management Band 101-125 (2024). Career360 AAA+. Outlook Top 3 Emerging B-Schools (2025). 2nd in Haryana B-school rankings per Business Today. Accreditations: UGC recognised (Gurugram and Greater Noida), NBA (selected programmes), SAQS (management school), AIU member. NAAC: under process for all IILM campuses, not yet awarded to any campus. Source: iilm.ac.in Public Self-Disclosure document.

NIMS University: NIRF 2025: Overall Band 151-200; University Band 101-150; Pharmacy #79. QS Asian Rankings (Southern Asia) 2026: #362. QS I-Gauge Diamond. NIMS is primarily recognised as a medical and health sciences university. Pharmacy and medical disciplines are its strongest academic divisions by national ranking. NIRF does not list NIMS in its Management top 100 based on the available 2025 data. UGC recognised (confirmed at nimsuniversity.org/faq.php). NAAC-accredited, the official NIMS website confirms NAAC accreditation but does not state a specific grade; verify the current grade at naac.gov.in.

For MBA-specific rankings, IILM has a clear record in management-focused national surveys. NIMS’s national ranking strength is in health sciences and pharmacy. Both are UGC-recognised and NAAC-accredited.

IILM: Business Today 2025 (#47); India Today 2024 (#42 MBA); Career360 AAA+; NIRF 2024 Management Band 101-125; Outlook 2025 Top 3 Emerging B-Schools. NIMS: Shiksha.com (NIRF 2025 Pharmacy #79, Overall 151-200, University 101-150, QS Asian Southern Asia #362 — all confirmed); naac.gov.in (NAAC grade — verify current cycle).

MBA Programme Comparison — IILM vs NIMS

IILM MBA: 2-year full-time programme at Gurugram and Greater Noida campuses. 10+ specialisations including Finance & FinTech, AI & Business Analytics with HCL Tech, Marketing & Psychology, HRM & Psychology, Operations & SCM with Blue Ocean Group, ESG & Sustainability, Law & Public Policy, and Entrepreneurship & Innovation with T-Hub. Selection: entrance score (CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, NMAT, GMAT, or ATMA) + Group Discussion + Personal Interview. External co-certifications: KPMG Financial Modelling and Valuation, EY HR Analytics, HCL Tech Industry Project, Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (for all MBA students). 3-phase Corporate Readiness Programme (CRP), Phases 2 and 3 delivered by recruiting companies. IILM Student Wallet Rs 1,00,000 for certifications, global immersion, and skill development.

NIMS MBA: 2-year full-time MBA through NIMS School of Business. 25+ MBA specialisations including Marketing, Finance, HR, IT, Operations, SCM, Digital Marketing, Hospital and Healthcare Management, Banking Management, Event Management, Logistics Management, Retail Management, Project Management, Pharmaceutical Management, International Business, Aviation Management, Media and Entertainment, Sports Management, Travel and Tourism, Agribusiness Management, Family Business and Entrepreneurship, and more. Integrated MBA and distance mode programmes are also available. Admission via NIMSEE (NIMS entrance exam) or national exams (MAT, CAT, GMAT, NMAT, CMAT). International MoUs with Johns Hopkins University (USA), King’s College London, University of Ljubljana (Europe), and Russian University of Cooperation provide academic exposure. The Healthcare Management specialisation is a genuine differentiator. NIMS’s on-campus hospital and medical infrastructure gives this track practical depth unavailable at a standalone management school.

Key programme difference: IILM’s MBA has fewer specialisations but deeper industry integration within each track, co-certifications from named companies, CRP delivered by recruiters, and an NCR corporate network that operates year-round. NIMS has broader specialisation breadth, and its Healthcare Management MBA is uniquely supported by on-campus hospital and clinical infrastructure. Students targeting healthcare, medical administration, or clinical management careers will find NIMS’s ecosystem, which includes MBBS, dental, nursing, and pharmacy alongside management, to be a distinctive advantage.

IILM MBA: apply.iilm.edu/mba-pgdm-2026/ (official); iilm.edu/greater-noida/mba/ (CRP phases confirmed). NIMS MBA: nimsuniversity.org (NIMS School of Business, 17 specialisations confirmed from official website — verified via Shiksha and Radhya Education Academy citing nimsuniversity.org); International MoUs: Shiksha.com, Careers360 (Johns Hopkins, King’s College London, University of Ljubljana confirmed).

Placement Records — NCR vs Jaipur

IILM University (MBA Batch 2024-26, official data): 100% placement assistance. Average package Rs 8.6 LPA. Top 10% average CTC Rs 13.64 LPA. Highest package Rs 26 LPA. 500+ recruiting companies. Named confirmed offers: Lloyds Technology Centre Rs 16.07 LPA, BlackRock Rs 9.85 LPA, AYE Finance Rs 11.56 LPA, L’Oreal Rs 8.65 LPA, Oxane Partners Rs 10.70 LPA. Sector distribution: Consulting 17%, IT and Analytics 14%, BFSI 13%, Real Estate 10%, E-commerce 8%, Manufacturing 7%, FMCG 5%. Source: apply.iilm.edu/mba-pgdm-2026/ (official IILM admissions page).

NIMS University (2025 placement data): University-wide highest domestic package Rs 1 Crore highest package (confirmed at nimsuniversity.org/nims-school-of-business/ official page). 2,000+ active recruiters. Named recruiters confirmed from the official NIMS website (nimsuniversity.org/faq.php): TCS, Infosys, Google, Wipro, Apollo, Fortis, Cipla. MBA-specific average package is not separately published from the overall university figure. The Rs 1 Crore highest package is university-wide across all schools and is not MBA-specific.

The placement transparency gap: IILM publishes named offers and batch-level averages specifically for the MBA programme. NIMS’s placement data is aggregated across all schools. For a like-for-like MBA placement comparison, ask NIMS School of Business directly for MBA-specific placement figures, placement percentage of enrolled MBA students, and named recruiter offers with confirmed amounts, and cross-check at nirfindia.org for NIRF-submitted data.

IILM: apply.iilm.edu/mba-pgdm-2026/ (official). NIMS: Careers360 (nimsuniversity.org/nims-school-of-business/ (official — Rs 1 Crore highest package, 2,000+ recruiters, TCS/Infosys/Google/Wipro confirmed); NIRF 2025 cross-verified at nirfindia.org.

Location Advantage — Why NCR Matters for MBA Placement

Geography is not just a lifestyle consideration for MBA students; it directly affects placement quality, recruiter access, and the professional network you build during the degree.

Delhi NCR advantage: Delhi NCR hosts India’s highest concentration of Fortune 500 India offices, in Gurugram’s Cyber City and DLF belt (Deloitte, KPMG, EY, PwC, Google, HSBC, American Express, Maruti Suzuki), in Greater Noida’s tech parks (HCL Tech, Samsung, multiple GCCs), and across Delhi (government ministries, PSU headquarters, bank headquarters). Recruiters at large companies budget for limited campus visit capacity. Campuses that are geographically convenient tend to receive more frequent, higher-quality recruiter visits, which is why a campus 3 km from Cyber City has a structural placement advantage over one 200+ km away, even if the latter is a strong institution.

Jaipur advantage: Jaipur is not a corporate backwater. It has a growing IT and business services sector; HCL Tech, Infosys BPM, Wipro, Genpact, and multiple fintech and e-commerce companies have operations there. For students who intend to work in Rajasthan or the Jaipur–Delhi corridor, NIMS’s location is an advantage: lower cost of living during the MBA, Rajasthan government and PSU connection access, and proximity to NIMS’s extensive medical and research infrastructure. Students from Rajasthan, UP, and Bihar who want to be closer to home during their studies may find NIMS’s location practical.

The commute reality for placement: MBA recruiters from Gurugram-headquartered companies (consulting, BFSI, FMCG, technology) can visit IILM Gurugram between morning and afternoon and return to their offices the same day. The same visit from Jaipur requires overnight travel. This logistics difference shows up in recruiter visit frequency. Students who want placement at Gurugram MNCs, Tier-1 consulting firms, or NCR-based global banks should weigh this proximity factor carefully.

Faculty and Research

IILM University: Faculty at IILM’s School of Management hold postgraduate qualifications from IIMs, FMS Delhi, and other national institutions, alongside industry experience in consulting, banking, and management. The teaching methodology integrates case studies, live industry projects (through CRP and co-certifications), and guest faculty from recruiting companies. IILM’s research culture is developing; the institution is building a publication and research framework alongside its teaching mission.

NIMS University: NIMS has a strong research profile in medical and health sciences, with on-campus hospitals providing research infrastructure that is rare among private universities. The Management School faculty credentials are less prominently published. NIMS’s broader academic infrastructure, 20,000+ students, 5,500 faculty, on-campus hospital, NABL-certified labs, reflects a genuine research culture in its core disciplines (medicine, pharmacy, biomedical sciences). For the MBA programme specifically, ask NIMS School of Business for faculty profiles, PhD percentages, and research publications before making a final decision.

IILM faculty: iilm.edu/faculty (official). NIMS faculty and research: Careers360 (5,500 faculty, 20,000+ students confirmed); CollegeBatch (NABH, NABL accreditation confirmed); Shiksha.com (20,000+ students, 250-acre campus).

IILM or NIMS — Which Should You Choose for an MBA?

Choose IILM if: your primary goal is an MBA with direct corporate placement access in Delhi NCR, the Gurugram campus is 3 km from Cyber City, and the Greater Noida campus is in a growing NCR tech corridor. If you want named industry co-certifications (KPMG, EY, HCL Tech, Microsoft) built into the degree, a CRP where recruiting companies train you directly, and published batch-level placement data you can verify. If you want a focused management school environment, smaller cohort, more direct faculty access, and 30+ years of management education legacy. For students from outside NCR who want to build a career in Delhi NCR, IILM’s location is the most direct investment into that outcome.

Choose NIMS if: you are from Rajasthan, UP, or Bihar and want to stay closer to home during your studies. If your MBA goal includes the Healthcare Management specialisation, NIMS’s on-campus hospital and medical school provide clinical management exposure that no standalone B-school can match. If you want the broadest multi-disciplinary campus in Rajasthan, studying alongside MBBS, pharmacy, dental, nursing, engineering, law, and architecture students in a residential environment. If the 17-specialisation MBA menu, international MoUs with Johns Hopkins and King’s College London, or the 250-acre campus experience are important to your choice.

Frequently Asked Questions
Is IILM better than NIMS University?

For MBA specifically, IILM has stronger management-focused national rankings (Business Today #47 2025; India Today MBA #42 2024; NIRF Management Band 101-125) and a direct Delhi NCR placement ecosystem. NIMS is a broader multi-disciplinary university with stronger national rankings in health sciences (NIRF Pharmacy #79, 2025) and a 250-acre campus in Jaipur that is India’s largest self-financed private university in Rajasthan. Neither is universally better; IILM is the stronger choice for corporate placement in NCR; NIMS is the stronger choice for breadth of programmes, campus scale, and Rajasthan-based careers.

Which has better MBA placement — IILM or NIMS?

IILM publishes specific, named, MBA-batch-level placement data: Rs 8.6 LPA average, Rs 13.64 LPA top 10% average, Rs 26 LPA highest, 500+ recruiters, 100% placement assistance, all from MBA Batch 2024-26 (source: apply.iilm.edu/mba-pgdm-2026/). NIMS publishes university-wide placement figures: Rs 1 Crore highest package (confirmed from nimsuniversity.org official site), 2,000+ active recruiters, but the MBA-specific average is not separately published. For a direct MBA placement comparison, ask NIMS School of Business for MBA-specific figures and cross-reference at nirfindia.org.

Is NIMS University UGC recognised?

Yes, NIMS University, Jaipur, is recognised by the University Grants Commission under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956. This makes its degrees legally valid for government employment, competitive examinations (UPSC, IBPS, PSC), and international postgraduate admissions. NIMS is also approved by AICTE, BCI, MCI/NMC, DCI, PCI, INC, COA, and AIU, and is NAAC-accredited. Verify current UGC recognition at ugc.gov.in and current NAAC grade at naac.gov.in before applying.

What is IILM’s MBA ranking?

IILM University’s MBA is ranked #47 by Business Today (2025), #42 for MBA by India Today (2024), 2nd in Haryana per Business Today’s Haryana B-school ranking, and Career360 AAA+. IILM is included in Outlook India’s Top 3 Emerging B-Schools (2025). In NIRF 2024, IILM’s management programmes appear in Band 101-125 of the Management category (nirfindia.org). These are verified figures from named ranking bodies, verifiable at the respective publication websites.

IILM Gurugram or NIMS Jaipur — which to choose?

The decision comes down to two questions: where do you want to build your career, and what do you want from your MBA experience? If you want to work in Delhi NCR, in consulting, BFSI, technology, FMCG, or real estate, IILM Gurugram’s Golf Course Road campus places you 3 km from the corporate corridor where most of those companies sit, with a placement cell that operates year-round in that ecosystem. If you want to stay in Rajasthan, work in healthcare management, or value a large multi-disciplinary residential campus with 250 acres and students from medical, engineering, law, and sciences, NIMS Jaipur offers an environment that a focused NCR management school cannot replicate. For corporate MBA career outcomes in India’s largest employment hubs, the NCR location is a material advantage.

Developer Finance

Real estate developers require constant financing for undertaking the construction and development of their projects. Timely and adequate access to capital is an important milestone in the project lifecycle, assisting the Real Estate developers to deliver their projects on time.

We at Tata Capital understand these needs and, therefore, provide construction finance or construction loan to real estate developers in select Indian cities. Our team of specialists understand and analyze your precise requirements and select the right loan product for your  real estate development business. You can also customize your loan amount, tenure, moratorium, repayment frequency, and others as per the nature and status of your proposed project.

What is a Developer Finance and Construction Finance?

A construction loan or construction finance is a special kind of loan sanctioned to real estate developers to develop or construct a new real estate project. At Tata Capital, we offer construction finance to individuals or firms engaged in the business of developing real estate projects. Also known as a building loan, our construction loans come with long repayment tenures and competitive interest rates.

Developer finance can assist real estate developers in the following ways:

Funding the construction of projects
Acquiring plot and raw materials
Paying contractors and labor
Complete payment cycles
Obtain permits and licenses
Acquire development rights under Joint Venture / Joint Development arrangements
Acquire projects from other developers/master developers
Features of Developer Finance

As a real estate developer , you can apply for Tata Capital’s Developer Finance / Construction Finance and fund all your financial requirements for developing a new real estate project. We offer construction finance for both residential and commercial projects. Below are a few prominent features of our construction loan:

Customizable Loan Offerings

Our construction loans are highly customizable. You can select your loan amount, loan tenure, and repayment frequency as per the projects requirement.

Loan Amount

With Tata Capital’s Construction Finance, you can get an adequate loan amount that can meet the funding requirements of various stages of your project construction/development.

Affordable Interest Rates

Our construction loan interest rates are highly competitive. With affordable interest rates, we ensure that you don’t feel the burden of paying higher EMIs.

Efficient Processing

We understand your business requirements and work along with you to structure a balanced funding proposition for your development/project need. It means that you won’t have to wait too much to start the construction of your project

Tata Capital Advantages

Below are the reasons to choose Tata Capital as your developer finance/construction finance partner:

Customizable solutions

End-to-end financing

Multiple repayment options

Appropriate moratorium period

Personalized approach

Developer Finance Eligibility

At Tata Capital, we offer developer finance to real estate builders who can fulfill very simple eligibility criteria. The loan size, repayment schedule, loan tenure, asset cover, interest rate, and loan fees for our developer/construction loans are generally determined based on our evaluation of the real estate project and developer, as well as the existing market conditions. The facilities offer are priced on a Risk Based pricing model offering competitive terms.

Construction Equipment Finance

Companies engaged in the business of construction, mining, material handling, and material processing are the key drivers of the Indian infrastructural growth story. However, these companies require significant funding from time to time to maintain their daily operations. A noteworthy amount is required to procure costly construction equipment and heavy machinery.

We at Tata Capital understand the needs of real estate developers and hence, provide construction equipment financing at affordable interest rates. Our construction equipment loan can cater to your widespread requirements, including new asset finance, refinance, working capital demands, top-up loans, letters of credit, and structured finance, among others. Leasing construction equipment is seen as a better alternative to buying, since it gives a chance to deploy construction equipment without having to bear the burden of large cost or long-term investments. Furthermore, leasing is one of the cheapest and best options for construction companies to free up their line of credit.


What is a Construction Equipment Loan?

A construction equipment loan is given to individuals or companies engaged in the business of real estate development or construction. The primary purpose of this loan is to help the borrower acquire costly equipment and heavy machinery required for the construction of buildings and other real estate projects. Tata Capital’s Construction Equipment Financing is one of the affordable and best options for construction companies to procure costly apparatus and free up their line of credit.

Also known as a heavy machinery loan, a construction equipment loan can be used to procure the following machines and equipment:

Excavators
Backhoe Loaders

Graders
Bulldozers
Wheel tractor scrapers
Mixing Plants
Reach Stackers
Forklift Crushers
Trenchers
Tower cranes

Boring machines

What is Debt Syndication?

Tata Capital recognizes the increasing need for an uninterrupted flow of funds to your growing business. We offer debt syndication services in both rupee and foreign currency through our vast network of associate banks / NBFCs. We can help you raise funds for your business expansions and acquisitions, refinance your existing business or restructure your debt with our hybrid solutions aimed at debt capital markets.

Lease Rental Discounting

Being a property owner, you must be earning rentals from your property at regular intervals. Tata Capital’s Lease Rental Discounting Solutions will help you en-cash on these rentals by availing loan facility at attractive interest rates against the lease rentals. Lease rentals received from the tenant on a monthly basis are used as collaterals while applying for loan. The bank will examine long-term cash flow and provide the loan based on the exact amount. This loan is then payable by the rents promised.

The tenant or the lessee has to make the payment in monthly for the lease period. Tata Capital’s Lease Rental Discounting helps you make the most out of these rental cash flows to generate further assets, which can yield higher returns. Furthermore, these funds can also be deployed for various requirements.

The following documents are required for the transaction:

Registered/Unregistered Lease Agreement between Lessor and Lessee
Property documents/sale deed/agreement to sale of the property to be leased/offered as security
Valuation of the property to be offered as security/Lease property
Title Search Report to establish the rightful ownership of the property belongs to the  Lessor


The loan may be financed for any productive purpose such as repairs (renovation/alteration/ addition) of the building, purchase of property, acquisition, expansion, projects and any other business related requirements like additional funds requirement, refinance of existing debt etc.

What is a Letter of Credit?

The companies you do business with, undoubtedly have impeccable credentials. But why take a chance? Tata Capital, with its associate banks, offers Letter of Credit (LC) facilities which arms you with guarantee of payment - especially useful while transacting with companies you have had limited exposure to and also for importing your capital goods from any part of the world. We offer two types of letter of credit - Sight and Usance LCs, both inland and foreign.

Considering the dynamic nature of international dealings like distance and differing laws, the use of letters of credit has become a critical aspect of international trade. Our Letter of Credit will provide you with the highest security and minimize your credit risk. Tata Capital’s Letter of Credit gets sanctioned and issued quickly, and is competitively priced.

With Tata Capital, you may leverage your investment portfolio of equity shares, mutual fund units, or debt instruments etc. for meeting expansion requirements, working capital requirements or meeting other business exigencies without having to dilute your investments.

Tata Securities Limited (TSL) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Capital Limited. The Company is a member of the Bombay Stock Exchange Limited (BSE) in the cash and derivatives segment. The Company is also a Depository Participant of Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL) and of National Securities Depository Limited (NSDL).

Our Offerings

Tata Capital's range of offerings caters to the diverse financial requirements of its retail, corporate and institutional customers, directly or indirectly, through its subsidiaries.

Commercial Finance
Investment Banking
Private Equity
Asset Finance
Investments
Consumer Loans
Tata Cards
Cleantech Finance
Leasing Services
Commercial Finance

The Commercial Finance* business helps small, medium and large corporates grow their business. Our range of offerings includes Term Loans, Working Capital Loans, Channel Finance, Equipment Finance, Lease Rental Discounting, Bill Discounting, Letter of Credit and Bank Guarantee**.

Our Brand Promise

For over 150 years, the Tata Group has engaged in the task of nation-building. Tata Capital, born of this legacy of trust and integrity, has always been about more than just ‘financial services’. Our mission– to connect people to opportunities. Opportunities that make the impossible dream, possible that give young ambition the wings to soar. By embracing simplicity, un-complicating the complexity of finance, by being there for the customer, when it matters. By staying true to a tradition of putting people before profit, by believing that not everything that counts can be counted, and that true wealth creation is about enriching lives and building enduring bonds. By committing ourselves to grow everyone we serve - individuals, businesses, and communities and by being an institution people can count on.  

Our Values
Integrity

We will be fair, honest, transparent and ethical in our conduct; everything we do must stand the test of public scrutiny.

Pioneering

We will be bold and agile courageously taking on challenges, using deep customer insight to develop innovative solutions.

Unity

We will invest in our people and partners, enable continuous learning, and build caring and collaborative relationships based on trust and mutual respect.

Responsibility

We will integrate environmental and social principles in our businesses, ensuring that what comes from the people goes back to the people many times over.

Excellence

We will be passionate about achieving the highest standards of quality, always promoting meritocracy.

Our Purpose Pillars
Integrity

We respect and reinforce the trust that is placed in us. We are the lender the country can rely on.

Better Together

We actively collaborate with group companies, partners, employees, customers, communities; their success is our success.

Future Ready

We innovate and leverage technology to anticipate, serve and shape future needs; setting the path for others to follow.

Faster Forward

We bring speed and simplicity; accelerating the pace at which the future becomes the present.

Capital & More

We serve the customer through the life-cycle of needs. We are facilitators and counsellors in helping customers achieve their dreams.

Delivering Delight

We go above and beyond to care and make people happy. We deliver smiles and delight in everything we do.

Our Culture
Know

Knowledge. It is what empowers to us to make a difference in the lives of our customers. It is the fuel that will power the engine of innovation. It is what will enhance our ability to predict the change and adapt quickly and effectively. So, let us begin each day with a strong desire to know more, for only when we strengthen our pursuit towards excellence.

Care

Care. It is at the core of all our relationships. It is what forges bonds that endure the test of time. It is about demonstrating humility and understanding towards all. Care is an appreciation of the truth, that in unity and in keeping 'we' before 'me', we will truly progress.

Do

Do, it is what separates aspirations from reality. It calls for a heightened sense of responsibility and passion to give our best at all times. And to 'Do Right' is a higher calling. It calls for integrity - a constant practice of honesty, transparency and fairness. It calls for courage. So, let's do right, for it is what gives us our unique identity, our unique strength.

Undergraduate Scholarship
Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships

Half of India’s population, or over 600 million Indians, are under the age of 25. Reliance Foundation is committed to strengthening young people’s access to higher education in India. Every year the Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships supports upto 5,000 meritorious students based on a merit-cum-means criteria for their undergraduate college education, empowering them to continue their studies without financial burden. The Scholarships aim to enable students to become successful professionals and realise their dreams, unlocking their potential to lift themselves and their communities up and contribute towards India’s future socio-economic development.

Students with a household income of under Rs. 15 lakh who are enrolled in first year (academic year 2026-27) of their undergraduate studies pursuing any subject stream can apply. The programme will also aim to encourage applications by girls and specially-abled students.

Selected scholars will receive a scholarship of up to 2 lakhs over the duration of their degree programme. In addition to the scholarship grant, the Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships will provide scholars an opportunity to be part of a vibrant alumni network and an enabling support system that will create a long-term impact on their lives and career trajectories.

KNOW MORE

Start here

Learn about the scholarship, or jump ahead to eligibility and apply.

Scholarships for UG for all streams Watch this!
Scholarship Features
Support meritorious students from all corners of the country with an undergraduate college education
For first year students studying any stream of their choice
Awarded on a merit-cum-means basis to meritorious students
Up to 5,000 undergraduate scholars will be selected
The total amount of scholarship available over the duration of the degree programme, will be up to Rs/INR 2 Lakhs
Scholarship will go beyond financial support, with students automatically gaining networking opportunities through a strong alumni network
Scholarship Values
Excellence

Scholars who are committed to excellence, in spirit and action, in everything they pursue, both academic and non-academic. Scholars who have a mindset of giving their best, seeking new and better ways to approach challenges and continually work to improve themselves.

Leadership Potential

Scholars who have the potential and ambition to become India’s and the World’s Leaders of Tomorrow.

Integrity

Scholars who strive to be honest and forthright. They take accountability and responsibility for their actions, decisions, and behaviours.

Community Commitment

Scholars who show a moral force of character and instinct to lead in their communities for the advancement of society. Scholars who have a commitment to work for social good and give back to society.

Growth Mindset

Embodying Reliance’s spirit that “Growth is Life” we are looking for scholars that dream big and have an ever-evolving spirit. They possess a love of learning and continually striving to develop and improve themselves and support others to do the same.

Courage

Scholars who are resilient, patient, and tenacious. Students who embrace challenges with passion and conviction as opportunities to grow.

Application and Selection Process

Applications for the 2026-27 scholarships are now open.

Application Form

Students will start the application process by clicking on the link given below

Application components:

Personal and Contact Information
Academic Info
Achievements and awards
Supporting Documents
Aptitude Test

All applicants to answer the online aptitude test

Test duration will be 60 mins and will contain 60 Multiple Choice Questions

Components of the test include verbal ability, analytical and logical ability and numerical ability

Initial Selection

FIRST LEVEL SELECTION

Applications will be evaluated using a combination of aptitude test score, academic and personal information

ANNOUNCEMENT

ANNOUNCEMENT OF SCHOLARS – UP TO 5000 SCHOLARS

All candidates will be evaluated on the basis of merit cum means

Please read our Frequently Asked Questions if you have any questions.
For any additional questions, please text “hi” on WhatsApp to 7977 100 100, call our helpline on (011) 4117 1414 or click on the chatbot.
Please Click Here for sample Aptitude Test question paper.
Eligibility Criteria

You must fulfil the following eligibility criteria in order to apply:

Be a resident Indian citizen
Passed Standard 12th with minimum 60%
Currently enrolled in the 1st year (academic year 2026-27) in a regular full-time degree course in any stream
Students having House Hold income < Rs. 15 Lakhs (preference given to < Rs. 2.5 Lakhs)
Aptitude Test is mandatory

Following students are not eligible:

Students who are in the 2nd year or higher (have started their courses from academic year 2025-26 or before)
Students pursuing their degree through online, hybrid, remote, distance or any other non-regular modes
Students who have passed diploma after std. 10th
Students pursuing 2 year & 6 year undergraduate degree courses
Students who do not answer the mandatory aptitude test or are found cheating during the test

Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships

India is poised to lead the next wave of global change - from artificial intelligence to clean energy, biotechnology to advanced manufacturing, the nation is rapidly establishing itself as a hub for technology, research, and innovation, powered by a thriving digital infrastructure, vibrant startup culture, and youthful, ambitious workforce.

The nation’s flagship missions such as Digital India, Startup India, the National Quantum Mission, and Atmanirbhar Bharat are underpinned by the need for empowered technical talent. Our aspirations rest on the shoulders of our young innovators.

India’s vision for Viksit Bharat by 2047 aims to create a future-ready, inclusive, and self-reliant society. The next 25 years are critical to harnessing our demographic dividend, technological prowess, and spirit of innovation to shape a new India that leads in solving global challenges.

The Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarship is rooted in this vision. It aims to nurture a new generation of scientists, technologists, and changemakers who will lead India towards Viksit Bharat.

Each year, Reliance Foundation identifies 100 of India’s brightest postgraduate students from select future-ready courses in the fields of Engineering and Life Sciences to join the country’s most prestigious cohort of scholars. Through a generous grant and a robust development programme, these students will be empowered to pursue advanced studies and research in areas critical to national development and global progress.

First-year postgraduate students from institutes across India pursuing degree programmes in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Sciences, Mathematics and Computing, Electrical and/or Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Renewable and New Energy, Material Science & Engineering and Life Sciences are eligible to apply.

Scholars will not only benefit from financial support but also from holistic development opportunities, including expert interactions, industry exposure, and volunteering engagements. Through this, the programme aspires to create a dynamic cohort of future leaders who will innovate for the benefit of society and the world.

KNOW MORE

Start here

Learn about the scholarship, or jump ahead to eligibility and apply.

APPLY NOW
PG students, this one’s for you Watch this!
Scholarship Features
Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships aim to nurture a new generation of scientists, technologists, and changemakers who will lead India towards Viksit Bharat.
The Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships will identify and select the best and brightest students in India through a rigorous and competitive selection process.
We welcome applicants from all socio-economic backgrounds and scholarships will be granted on the basis of merit.
Up to 100 postgraduate scholars will be selected.
The total amount of scholarship available over the duration of the degree programme, will be up to Rs/INR 6 Lakhs.
80% of the funds will be granted in advance at the start of each academic year, to use for tuition and direct academic expenses. The remaining 20% of the funds will be granted upon request to support professional development, including indirect academic and personal development expenses, including conference related expenses.
Scholars will also benefit from additional engagement and development activities (including the chance to attend talks and workshops with leading global experts, opportunities to apply for mentoring/internships, volunteering opportunities, a strong alumni network and more), and will join a vibrant community of scholars that will be at the forefront of creating and building a new India.
Scholarship Values
Excellence

Scholars who are committed to excellence, in spirit and action, in everything they pursue, both academic and non-academic. Scholars who have a mindset of giving their best, seeking new and better ways to approach challenges and continually work to improve themselves.

Leadership Potential

Scholars who have the potential and ambition to become India’s and the World’s Leaders of Tomorrow.

Integrity

Scholars who strive to be honest and forthright. They take accountability and responsibility for their actions, decisions, and behaviours.

Community Commitment

Scholars who show a moral force of character and instinct to lead in their communities for the advancement of society. Scholars who have a commitment to work for social good and give back to society.

Growth Mindset

Embodying Reliance’s spirit that “Growth is Life” we are looking for scholars that dream big and have an ever-evolving spirit. They possess a love of learning and continually striving to develop and improve themselves and support others to do the same.

Courage

Scholars who are resilient, patient, and tenacious. Students who embrace challenges with passion and conviction as opportunities to grow.

Application and Selection Process

Applications for the 2026-27 scholarships are now open.

Registration

To apply, students need to first register on our website:

Application Form

Students fill and submit applications through our Application Portal:

Personal, Academic and Extra-curricular details
Two Letters of Reference: One that attests to your academic capabilities and one that attests to your character and leadership traits
Academic/ Prof. Info
Two Essays: Personal Statement and Statement of Purpose
Supporting Documents
Aptitude Test

All applicants to answer the online aptitude test

Test duration will be 60 mins and will contain 60 Multiple Choice Questions

Components of the test include verbal ability, analytical and logical ability and numerical ability

Evaluation Stage

FIRST LEVEL SELECTION

Applications will be evaluated by an expert panel of industry experts, academicians and leaders in the field

Interview Stage

SECOND LEVEL SELECTION

Interview preparation webinars will be conducted for all candidates

Interviews will be held virtually by the expert panel

Selection

ANNOUNCEMENT OF SCHOLARS — UP TO 100 SCHOLARS

All candidates will be evaluated on the basis of merit

Please read our Frequently Asked Questions if you have any questions.
For any additional questions, please text “hi” on WhatsApp to 7977 100 100, call our helpline on (011) 4117 1414 or click on the chatbot.
Eligibility Criteria

Reliance Foundation invites first year postgraduate students who are enrolled full-time in an eligible degree programme (in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics & Computing, Electrical and/or Electronics Engg., Chemical Engg., Mechanical Engg., Renewable & New Energy, Material Science & Engg. and Life Sciences) to apply.

Click here to access the full list of eligible programmes.

You must fulfil the following eligibility criteria in order to apply:

Be a resident Indian citizen
First year PG Students who secured a score of 550 - 1,000 in the GATE Examination.
OR
Students who have scored 7.5 or above in their Undergraduate CGPA (or % normalised to CGPA)
Eligible degree programmes – Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics & Computing, Electrical/or Electronics Engg., Chemical Engg., Mechanical Engg., Renewable & New Energy, Material, Science & Engg. and Life Sciences (as per the list above).

Following students are not eligible:

Students who are in the 2nd year of their PG programme
Students pursuing their degree through online, remote, distance, hybrid, part-time or any other non-regular modes
Students pursuing only Mathematics cannot apply under Mathematics & Computing
Students who do not answer the mandatory aptitude test or are found cheating during the test

Reliance Foundation’s prestigious Scholarships open for applications: to award 5,100 first-year UG & PG students
14 August, 2026
Mumbai
5 min read

Over 33,000 students across India have been supported through Reliance’s scholarships till date

Scholarship of up to Rs. 2 lakhs for UG and up to Rs. 6 lakhs for PG students, with no application fee
The scholarship programme combines financial support with mentorship, leadership development and a vibrant scholar community, nurturing the minds of India
Applications invited from first-year undergraduate and postgraduate students enrolled in full-time degree programmes across India
5,000 Undergraduate Scholarships and 100 Postgraduate Scholarships to be awarded for the academic year 2026–27

Mumbai, August 14, 2026: On the eve of India’s Independence Day, Reliance Foundation announced the opening of applications for its flagship Reliance Foundation Scholarships 2026–27, reaffirming its commitment to nurturing the next generation of leaders, innovators, and changemakers contributing to India’s growth story.

Education has the power to transform lives, strengthen communities and build nations. Guided by this belief, the Reliance Foundation Scholarships have been identifying and supporting exceptional young talent across the country, enabling scholars to pursue higher education with confidence while equipping them with opportunities to grow, reaching thousands of students.

While Reliance has been providing scholarships for over three decades, in December 2022, on the 90th birth anniversary of Reliance Founder-Chairman Shri Dhirubhai Ambani, Mrs Nita M Ambani, Founder & Chairperson, Reliance Foundation, announced an additional commitment of 50,000 scholarships over 10 years, making it one of India’s largest private scholarship programmes. Till date, Reliance has awarded over 33,000 scholarships. Last year, the 5,100 selected scholars were from 1,350 institutions across 27 states and seven Union Territories, reflecting the breadth of talent and aspirations from different parts of India.

The Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships support 5,000 meritorious students every year, through a merit-cum-means selection process, enabling deserving students from diverse socio-economic backgrounds to pursue higher education and realise aspirations.

The Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships recognise 100 exceptional students annually, pursuing future-ready disciplines, including Engineering, Technology, Energy and Life Sciences. Awarded on the basis of academic excellence and aptitude, the scholarships seek to nurture researchers, innovators and professionals to address the challenges of tomorrow. Selected undergraduate students will be provided a scholarship of up to Rs. 2 lakhs, while postgraduate students will receive a scholarship of up to Rs. 6 lakhs, through the duration of their programme.

In addition to the grants, the Reliance Foundation Scholarships provide a holistic development journey with mentorship, leadership development programmes, networking opportunities, interactions with industry experts and a vibrant scholar community to build skills, confidence and perspective to create meaningful impact. Eligible students can apply online through https://scholarships.reliancefoundation.org/. The undergraduate selection process includes an aptitude assessment and financial background, while postgraduate applicants will be assessed through academic merit, aptitude and other selection parameters. There is no fee at any stage of the application process.

Enabling students to dream big

Through the years, Reliance Foundation scholars have proceeded to excel across technology, healthcare, research, academia, entrepreneurship, public leadership and several other fields, creating meaningful impact within their communities and beyond. Reliance Foundation looks forward to welcoming another cohort of exceptional young minds whose ideas, innovations and leadership will help shape the India of tomorrow.

Reliance Foundation Scholarships
Nurturing India’s youth and future leaders

Reliance has been providing scholarships to meritorious students for over 29 years, inspired by its Founder-Chairman Shri Dhirubhai Ambani’s belief that the best way to ensure the nation’s progress is to invest in its youth. Reliance Foundation Scholarships aim to nurture and empower students, enabling them to pursue higher education.

In pursuing a brighter tomorrow, Reliance Foundation recognises the transformative power of education and the pivotal role of scholarships in making this a reality for many young people. Over the years, these scholarships have touched the lives of over 33,000 deserving students in India, opening doors of opportunity and nurturing future leaders.

The Dhirubhai Ambani Scholarship (DAS), established in 1996, awards scholarships to students from underprivileged backgrounds. It empowers outstanding students to pursue their dreams of higher education, regardless of financial constraints. With 12,776 students benefitting from DAS across India, the impact reaches far and wide, embracing diversity and inclusivity.

In 2020-21, the Reliance Foundation Scholarships (RFS) took flight, aiming to support India's brightest youth in fields like Artificial Intelligence, Computer Sciences, Mathematics & Computing, and Electrical and/or Electronics Engineering. The rigorous selection process identifies 100 exceptional students annually, enabling them to soar and lead India's technological growth.

In December 2022, on the occasion of the 90th birth anniversary of Shri Dhirubhai Ambani, Founder - Chairman of Reliance Industries Limited, Reliance Foundation announced that it will significantly strengthen its commitment to youth, awarding 50,000 scholarships over the next 10 years for students pursuing higher education in India.

Since 2022-2023, Reliance Foundation has been supporting 5,100 students annually, including 5,000 meritorious undergraduate students from underprivileged sections of society studying any stream of their choice through the Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships, and 100 of India's brightest postgraduate students studying eligible subjects in new technologies through the Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships.

Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships

Half of India’s population, or over 600 million Indians, are under the age of 25. Reliance Foundation is committed to strengthening young people’s access to higher education in India. Every year the Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships supports upto 5,000 meritorious students based on a merit-cum-means criteria for their undergraduate college education, empowering them to continue their studies without financial burden. The Scholarships aim to enable students to become successful professionals and realise their dreams, unlocking their potential to lift themselves and their communities up and contribute towards India’s future socio-economic development.

Students with a household income of under Rs. 15 lakh who are enrolled in first year (academic year 2026-27) of their undergraduate studies pursuing any subject stream can apply. The programme will also aim to encourage applications by girls and specially-abled students.

Selected scholars will receive a scholarship of up to 2 lakhs over the duration of their degree programme. In addition to the scholarship grant, the Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships will provide scholars an opportunity to be part of a vibrant alumni network and an enabling support system that will create a long-term impact on their lives and career trajectories.

Scholars who are committed to excellence, in spirit and action, in everything they pursue, both academic and non-academic. Scholars who have a mindset of giving their best, seeking new and better ways to approach challenges and continually work to improve themselves.

Leadership Potential

Scholars who have the potential and ambition to become India’s and the World’s Leaders of Tomorrow.

Integrity

Scholars who strive to be honest and forthright. They take accountability and responsibility for their actions, decisions, and behaviours.

Community Commitment

Scholars who show a moral force of character and instinct to lead in their communities for the advancement of society. Scholars who have a commitment to work for social good and give back to society.

Growth Mindset

Embodying Reliance’s spirit that “Growth is Life” we are looking for scholars that dream big and have an ever-evolving spirit. They possess a love of learning and continually striving to develop and improve themselves and support others to do the same.

Courage

Scholars who are resilient, patient, and tenacious. Students who embrace challenges with passion and conviction as opportunities to grow.

Aptitude Test is mandatory

Students who are in the 2nd year or higher (have started their courses from academic year 2025-26 or before)
Students pursuing their degree through online, hybrid, remote, distance or any other non-regular modes

Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships

India is poised to lead the next wave of global change - from artificial intelligence to clean energy, biotechnology to advanced manufacturing, the nation is rapidly establishing itself as a hub for technology, research, and innovation, powered by a thriving digital infrastructure, vibrant startup culture, and youthful, ambitious workforce.

The nation’s flagship missions such as Digital India, Startup India, the National Quantum Mission, and Atmanirbhar Bharat are underpinned by the need for empowered technical talent. Our aspirations rest on the shoulders of our young innovators.

India’s vision for Viksit Bharat by 2047 aims to create a future-ready, inclusive, and self-reliant society. The next 25 years are critical to harnessing our demographic dividend, technological prowess, and spirit of innovation to shape a new India that leads in solving global challenges.

The Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarship is rooted in this vision. It aims to nurture a new generation of scientists, technologists, and changemakers who will lead India towards Viksit Bharat.

Each year, Reliance Foundation identifies 100 of India’s brightest postgraduate students from select future-ready courses in the fields of Engineering and Life Sciences to join the country’s most prestigious cohort of scholars. Through a generous grant and a robust development programme, these students will be empowered to pursue advanced studies and research in areas critical to national development and global progress.

First-year postgraduate students from institutes across India pursuing degree programmes in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Sciences, Mathematics and Computing, Electrical and/or Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Renewable and New Energy, Material Science & Engineering and Life Sciences are eligible to apply.

Scholars will not only benefit from financial support but also from holistic development opportunities, including expert interactions, industry exposure, and volunteering engagements. Through this, the programme aspires to create a dynamic cohort of future leaders who will innovate for the benefit of society and the world.

Scholarship Features
Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships aim to nurture a new generation of scientists, technologists, and changemakers who will lead India towards Viksit Bharat.
The Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships will identify and select the best and brightest students in India through a rigorous and competitive selection process.
We welcome applicants from all socio-economic backgrounds and scholarships will be granted on the basis of merit.
Up to 100 postgraduate scholars will be selected.
The total amount of scholarship available over the duration of the degree programme, will be up to Rs/INR 6 Lakhs.
80% of the funds will be granted in advance at the start of each academic year, to use for tuition and direct academic expenses. The remaining 20% of the funds will be granted upon request to support professional development, including indirect academic and personal development expenses, including conference related expenses.
Scholars will also benefit from additional engagement and development activities (including the chance to attend talks and workshops with leading global experts, opportunities to apply for mentoring/internships, volunteering opportunities, a strong alumni network and more), and will join a vibrant community of scholars that will be at the forefront of creating and building a new India.
Scholarship Values
Excellence

Scholars who are committed to excellence, in spirit and action, in everything they pursue, both academic and non-academic. Scholars who have a mindset of giving their best, seeking new and better ways to approach challenges and continually work to improve themselves.

Leadership Potential

Scholars who have the potential and ambition to become India’s and the World’s Leaders of Tomorrow.

Integrity

Scholars who strive to be honest and forthright. They take accountability and responsibility for their actions, decisions, and behaviours.

Community Commitment

Scholars who show a moral force of character and instinct to lead in their communities for the advancement of society. Scholars who have a commitment to work for social good and give back to society.

Growth Mindset

Embodying Reliance’s spirit that “Growth is Life” we are looking for scholars that dream big and have an ever-evolving spirit. They possess a love of learning and continually striving to develop and improve themselves and support others to do the same.

Courage

Scholars who are resilient, patient, and tenacious. Students who embrace challenges with passion and conviction as opportunities to grow.

Applications for the 2026-27 scholarships are now open.

Supporting Documents

Test duration will be 60 mins and will contain 60 Multiple Choice Questions

Evaluation Stage

FIRST LEVEL SELECTION

Eligible degree programmes – Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics & Computing, Electrical/or Electronics Engg., Chemical Engg., Mechanical Engg., Renewable & New Energy, Material, Science & Engg. and Life Sciences (as per the list above).

Students who are in the 2nd year of their PG programme
